text:
I found 2 medicines in your prescription:

1. Dolo 650 - 1 tablet, morning and night, after food, for 5 days
2. Pantop 40 - 1 tablet, morning, before food, for 10 days

I am not a doctor. Please check with your doctor or pharmacist.

आपकी पर्ची में 2 दवाइयाँ मिलीं:

1. डोलो 650 - 1 गोली, सुबह और रात, खाने के बाद, 5 दिन
2. पैंटॉप 40 - 1 गोली, सुबह, खाने से पहले, 10 दिन

मैं डॉक्टर नहीं हूँ। अपने डॉक्टर या फ़ार्मासिस्ट से पूछ लें।

Aapki parchi me 2 dawai mili hain.

Dolo 650: 1 goli, subah aur raat, khane ke baad, 5 din.
Pantop 40: 1 goli, subah, khane se pehle, 10 din.

Main doctor nahi hoon. Doctor ya pharmacist se pooch lein.
This sounds like an emergency. Please call 112 or 108 now, or go to the nearest hospital.

Haemoglobin: 13.2 g/dL. The usual range is 13 to 17. This is inside the range.

Please ask your doctor if you have any questions.

हीमोग्लोबिन: 13.2 g/dL। सामान्य सीमा 13 से 17 है। आपका नतीजा इस सीमा के अंदर है।

कोई सवाल हो तो अपने डॉक्टर से पूछें।
Your haemoglobin is 11.2 g/dL, which is below the usual range of 13 to 17. A low value can have many reasons, so please ask your doctor what it means for you.
Aapka haemoglobin 11.2 hai, jo normal range 13 se 17 se kam hai. Iske kai karan ho sakte hain, isliye doctor se zaroor poochiye.
I could not read the dose of the second medicine clearly. Please confirm it with your pharmacist before you take it.
दूसरी दवाई की मात्रा मैं साफ़ नहीं पढ़ पाया। लेने से पहले अपने फ़ार्मासिस्ट से पक्का कर लें।
Two of your medicines contain the same ingredient, paracetamol. Taking both can mean too much of it. Please show both prescriptions to your doctor or pharmacist.
Aapki do dawaiyon me ek hi cheez hai: paracetamol. Dono lene se zyada ho sakta hai. Dono parche doctor ya pharmacist ko dikha dein.

A cheaper option with the same salt, strength and form is listed for 1 of your medicines. The saving shown is approximate and based on the listed price. Please ask your doctor or pharmacist before switching to it.

Your reminders are set for the next 36 hours. If you do not answer within 60 minutes of a reminder, that dose is marked as missed, and after two missed doses in a row the person you added will be told.

आपकी रिमाइंडर अगले 36 घंटों के लिए लगा दी गई हैं। अगर आप रिमाइंडर के 60 मिनट के अंदर जवाब नहीं देते हैं तो वह खुराक छूटी हुई मानी जाएगी और लगातार दो खुराकें छूटने पर आपके चुने हुए व्यक्ति को बताया जाएगा।

Result summary: 14 tests were read. 11 are inside the printed range, 2 are slightly above it and 1 is slightly below it. The tests outside the range are listed below with the lab's own range next to each value.
Report me 14 test padhe gaye. 11 range ke andar hain, 2 thode upar aur 1 thoda neeche. Range ke bahar wale tests neeche diye hain, har value ke saath lab ki apni range bhi.

Pursuant to the extracted line items, the aforementioned formulations exhibit overlapping active pharmaceutical ingredients; concomitant administration may result in cumulative exposure exceeding the recommended threshold, wherefore verification with the dispensing professional is advisable.
RESULT: HGB 11.2 L, TLC 7.2, PLT 1.1 L, MCV 71 L, MCH 23 L, MCHC 31.8, RDW 17 H. See ref ranges per lab. Consult physician.
परिणाम: Hb निम्न, MCV निम्न, RDW उच्च, प्लेटलेट निम्न। संदर्भ मान प्रयोगशाला के अनुसार। चिकित्सक से परामर्श अपेक्षित है।
I am unable to process this. Error. Retry later. If the problem persists contact support.
Hematological indices evidence hypochromic microcytic morphology with probable ferritin depletion; correlate clinically and consider iron repletion protocols pending reticulocyte indices.
YOU ARE IN DANGER!!! YOUR RESULTS ARE TERRIBLE. DO SOMETHING NOW OR IT WILL GET WORSE!!!
Arre yeh kya bhej diya? Itni kharab photo me kuch dikhta nahi. Dobara bhejo, aur is baar dhang se.
त्रुटि 0x5F3: अपेक्षित स्कीमा मान्य नहीं। टोकन सीमा पार। पुनः प्रयास करें।
Thank you. I have removed all your data. If you want to use Dawai Saathi again, just send Hi.
धन्यवाद। आपका सारा डेटा हटा दिया गया है। दोबारा इस्तेमाल करना हो तो बस Hi भेजें।
Reminder: it is time for Dolo 650 (1 tablet, after food). Did you take it?
Yaad dilana: Dolo 650 ka time ho gaya hai (1 goli, khane ke baad). Aapne le li?

I can only help with medicines, prescriptions and lab reports, so I cannot answer that. You can send a clear photo of your prescription or lab report, or ask me about a medicine. Send HELP to see everything I can do.
